sources.cite: AWS SDK for Python (Boto3) reference, S3 Client put_bucket_notification_configuration
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-17. Quoted: 'This action replaces the existing notification configuration with the configuration you include in the request body'; 'You can disable notifications by adding the empty NotificationConfiguration element'; EventBridgeConfiguration '{}' 'Enables delivery of events to Amazon EventBridge'. The S3 user guide page 'Using EventBridge' (read 2026-11-18) says that unlike other destinations you do not choose event types: 'After EventBridge is enabled, all events below are sent to EventBridge', including Object Created. That nothing is sent for objects created before delivery was enabled follows from events being sent as they happen, stated as the author's.
